correctness.rationale: The proof supplies conservation f_j-f_{j-1}=a_j-b_j and minimal nonnegative flow, then cuts at the minimum potential and constructs a feasible shortest trajectory. Blocking of any unfinished token propagates cyclically; all-blocked would force n=rk, impossible for positive slack. Unrolling gives individual displacement bound L=n-1-r(k-1); equality forces unique packed source and target up to rotation. Stars-and-bars counts states and legal arcs. Tested all 1,896,844 ordered pairs in 73 finite parameter cases via complete BFS and independent prefix arithmetic. Boundaries n=rk and r,k>=2 are explicit; finite checks only corroborate the proof.

value.rationale: The natural exact one-way relocation cost for hard-core particles on rings is solved for all exclusion radii, token counts and circumferences, including exact optimal directed routes, a sharp frozen/strongly-connected phase boundary, n uniquely classified worst-case pairs, and linear-time distance computation. This is a motivated global algorithmic metric invariant rather than an ad hoc small-instance table. The result does not claim physical mixing-time or stationary-current behavior.
